changes.title: Electron shell and native identity
changes.upstreamDependency: Electron shell may import the public profile boot entry; it must not own private Web implementation files.
changes.updateRule: Rebuild against the pinned upstream commit and verify the embedded runtime closure.

changes.title: Desktop chrome and outer frame
changes.upstreamDependency: Use the client module and root/layout extension points.
changes.updateRule: Do not edit apps/web/src/main.ts; mount a client plugin through a product patch.

changes.title: Composer, drag and attachment presentation
changes.upstreamDependency: Use conversation Composer and attachment Slots; model-visible content remains a Host contract.
changes.updateRule: Keep renderer presentation separate from durable attachment admission and serialization.

changes.title: Sidebar policy and Codex-like layout
changes.upstreamDependency: The official layout owns breakpoint policy; a stable policy extension point is required.
changes.updateRule: Do not maintain a DOM or CSS selector override for sidebar state.

changes.title: Durable file attachment contract
changes.upstreamDependency: The official content and session contracts currently center on image attachments.
changes.updateRule: Keep generic files behind a typed Host/API contract; never implement model-visible file input in the renderer alone.

changes.title: Profile patch and plugin loading
changes.upstreamDependency: Use public profile overlays and dsh.client module discovery.
changes.updateRule: Carry only product rows in the product patch; keep official bundle rows unchanged.

changes.title: Electron preload bridge contracts
changes.upstreamDependency: Renderer and Electron main communicate only through the typed preload bridge.
changes.updateRule: Version bridge messages with the product release and verify both faces together.

changes.title: Git-bound build, release lock, and retention
changes.upstreamDependency: Release identity is the pair of product and upstream Git trees.
changes.updateRule: A release requires clean worktrees, a version manifest, artifact hashes, and a retained version directory.
